name: Address DE
description: Adds Germany's 16 federal states (Bundesländer) as administrative-area subdivisions and appends a state field to the Address module's German (DE) address format.
project_description: Address DE is a lightweight add-on to the Address module that supplies Germany's 16 federal states (Bundesländer) as administrative-area subdivisions. On enable it registers a single event subscriber that reacts to the Address module's ADDRESS_FORMAT and SUBDIVISIONS events for the DE country code: it appends a state line to the German address format and returns the fixed list of states with their ISO 3166-2 codes. The CommerceGuys addressing library omits German states because they are not used for postal addressing, so this module adds them for sites that need them (e.g. reporting or filtering). It ships no configuration, routes, permissions, or schema — enabling the module is the whole setup.
